SABBEN, FREDERICK.—Ed. Royal Naval Sch., govt. agt., Fiji, July, 1882; inspr. of imigrts., Jan., 1883; boarding offr., Nov., 1883; bondkeeper, 2nd class clk., and magazine-keeper, Jan., 1884; inspr. of pol., and offr. in charge of gaol, May, 1886; gaoler, Aug., 1887; supt. prisons, Aug., 1903.

ST. AUBYN, GEOFFREY PETER.—Called to the bar, Mid. Tem., Apr., 1880; W. circuit, pol. mag., Kingstown, St. Vincent, 1891; mem. legis. coun., 1891; ag. ch. just., June, 1893; ag. treas., Nov., 1893; ag. atty.-gen., Dec. to May, 1894, and Nov., 1895; ag. ch. just., from Nov., 1896, to July, 1898; judge of Turks and Caicos Islda., July, 1898; ag. comsnr., 1899, 1900, 1901 and 1903.

ST. QUINTIN, C.—Clik. to A.A.G., Griqualand W., 1879; border pol., 1880; ag. sub. inspr., Cape pol., 1884; sub.-inspr., Bechuanaland pol., 1884; lieut., Bechuanaland border pol., 1885; inspr. of native reserves and J.P., 1887; storekeeper, 1889.

SALOMONS, SIR JULIAN EMANUEL, K.C., KT. BACH. (1891).—B. 1834; vice-pres., exec. coun., N.S. Wales, 1891; resig., 1893; mem. of legis. coun.; London agent-gen., N.S.W., 1899-1900.

SAMUEL, SILVERIC, L.—Ed. at St. Gregory’s Rom. Cath. gram. schl., Lagos; meser. and copyt., educ. off., Oct., 1897; clk. to inspr. of schls., Mar., 1899; sec. to comte. for exhibtn. of schl. wks., 1902 and 1903; clk. and interpreter to trav. comsnr., Ilesha interior dept., Feb., 1904; 3rd cls. clk., govr.’s off., Aug., 1904.

SAMUELSON, S. O.—Ag. regisr. native high ct., Natal, Feb., 1881, to Apr., 1882; ag. Zulu interp., sup. ct., May to June, 1882; clk. and Zulu interp. to R.M., Umlazi div., Oct., 1882; Zulu interp., sup. ct., Feb., 1888; under-sec. for native affairs, 1893; mem. of civ. ser. bd.; 1894-1901: J.P. for colony, 1894.

SANDERS, WM. RUTHERFORD BOGLE.—Cadet, Ceylon, 4th Oct., 1879; pol. mag., 1st Jan., 1888; dist. judge, 1st May, 1896; ag. govt. agt., N. prov., 21st Apr., 1902; officer of cls. II., 18th July, 1902.

SANDERSON, JAMES.—Clik. to ch. just., Barbados, 1867; clk. to gen. bd. of health, Barbados, Apr., 1871, also clk. to quarantine bd. in 1880; sofr., atty., and proctor, Barbados, in 1873; was deleg. for Barbados to quarantine confce. at Demerara in 1888; govt. dir. on bd. of Barbados rly. co. in 1891.

SANGSTER, G. H.—Served in 2nd Dragoons and 91st Highlanders; asst. supt. pol., Gambia, 1897; ag. supt. of pol. inspr. of prisons, Gambia, 1897; asst. inspr., S. Leone frontier force, 1898; Mendi expdtn., 1898, mentioned in despatches; ag. dist. comsnr., Karene, 1899; inspr., S. Leone F.F., June, 1899; W. Africa meda and clasp, S. Leone, 1898-9; Royal Humane Soc.’s bronze medal, 1898; asst. dist. comsnr., S. Leone, Dec., 1899-1900; travelling comsnr., Gambia, Nov., 1900; field treas., Gambia field force, 1901; special mention in despatches; priv. sec. to ag. govr. of Gambia.

SANGUINETTI, FREDERICK S., I.S.O. (1903).—1st class clk. in col. sec.’s office, Jamaica, Aug., 1878; clk. in office of main road comsnrs., Sept., 1863; clk. in office of exec. comte., Feb., 1864; 2nd class clk. in financial sec.’s office, 1866, and now in col. sec.’s office; was sec. to a coman. apptd. “to inquire into the condition of the juvenile population of Jamaica,” 1877; one of the compilers of the “Handbook of Jamaica, 1881;” ag. comsnr., Turks and Caicos Islda., 1883; and again, 1886; ag. col. sec., treas., and pol. mag., Falklands, July, 1890-1; admstr. of the govt. for a short time in 1891; ag. asst. col. sec., Jamaica, 1894-7; ret. on pension, 1898; comsnr. of Cayman Is., 1898.

SANKEY, JOHN.—Customs clk., England, Dec., 1886; excise offr., Jan., 1887; 2nd div. clk., June, 1887; ag. asst. P.O. survr., 1897; acctnt. dept. of posts and telegraphs, O.R.C., Sept., 1901; ch. acctnt. ditto, July, 1903.

SARTORIUS, MAJ.-GEN. REGINALD WILLIAM, C.M.G., V.C. (1874).—B. 1841; 6th regt. of Bengal cavalry; apptd. to the order of St. M. and St. G. for service in the Ashanti war, 1873-4, under Sir J. H. Glover, and received the V.C. for an act of conspicuous gallantry in saving a wounded sergt.-maj. of Houssas.

SARWAR, HAFIZ GHULAM.—Cadet, S. S., Sept., 1897; ag. 3rd mag., Singapore, Jan. to June, 1900; and from Sept., 1900, to Nov., 1901; passed final exam., Chinese, July, 1900; 3rd mag., Sing., 29th Apr., 1902; ag. sherif, deputy-regar., and asst. official assignee, Penang, May, 1902.

SAUER, THE HON. J. W.—Sec. for native affairs in Scanlen ministry, Cape pol., May, 1881; ret. 1884; col. sec., July, 1890, to Jan., 1896; comsnr. of pub. wks. in the Schreiner ministry, Oct., 1898, to 1900; mem. for George, 1904.

SAUNDERS, CHARLES J., B.A.—Ed. Merchant Taylors, and St. John’s Coll., Oxon.; cadet, S. S., 1891; passed final exam. in Chinese, Feb., 1896; ag. 2nd asst. prot. of Chinese, Feb., 1896; ag. 3rd mag., Singapore, May, 1895; ag. dist. offr. Penang, Mar., 1897; Malacca, May, 1897; ag. asst. prot. of Chinese, Singapore, Aug., 1897; ag. asst. prot. of Chinese, and supt. of Ind. immigr., Penang, June, 1898; ag. asst. prot. of Chinese, Singapore, Aug., 1898; also ag. 3rd mag., Singapore, Sept., 1898; 2nd asst. prot. of Chinese, Penang, Aug., 1898; still ag. at Singapore till Feb., 1899; ag. 2nd mag., Singapore, May, 1900; ag. offl. assignee, S. S., Jan., 1901; sherif, dep. regar., supreme court, and asst. official assignee, Penang, May, 1902; munic. comsnr. for Singapore, Sep., 1903; asst. prot. of Chin., Penang, but cont. to act as offl. assignee, Sing., May, 1904.

SAUNDERS, C. J. R., C.M.G. (1896).—B. 1857; clk. of the ct. and Zulu interp. to the R.M., Alexandra co., Natal, Nov., 1876; to the R.M., Durban, 1878; to the R.M., Alexandra, Nov., 1879; ag. ch. clk., office of sec. for native affairs during Zulu war, for the purpose of registering native levies, Apr., 1883; Zulu interp. sup. and circuit cte., Dec., 1883; ag. regisr. to the native high ct., Apr., 1884; asst. admstr. native law, Umlazi, Jan., 1886; ditto Inanda, June, 1886; proceeded to Amatongaland to ratify treaty with Queen of that country, Sept., 1887 (mentioned in despatches); R.M., Eshowe, Zululand, Jan., 1888; apptd. to define bndry. between Amatongaland and Zululand (again mentioned in despatches), July, 1889; asst. comsnr. and R.M., Lubombo, Aug., 1890; R.M., Eshowe, 1891; spec comsnr. to territories of Samban, Umbegiza, and Mohlatene, N. of Zululand, Apr., 1895; ch. mag. and civil comsnr., prov. of Zululand, 1897; col. govt. representative, Zululand delim. coman. 1902.

SAUNDERS, SIR FREDERICK RICHARD, K.C.M.G. (1897), C.M.G. (1886).—B. 1838; asst. survr., Ceylon, 1857; asst. agt., Trincomalee, July, 1862; asst. to govt. agt. at Kandy, Aug., 1865; dist. judge, etc., Ratnapura, Nov., 1865; asst. to the govt. agt., W. Prov., at Ratnapura, Oct., 1867; inspr. gen. of prisons, 1874; agt., E. Prov., 1878; agt. W. Prov., 1879; M.L.C., 1879; ag. audr.-gen., 1890; treas. and comsnr. of stamps, Oct., 1890; ag. audr.-gen., 1896; ret., 1898.
SAUNDERS, JAMES B.—Harbrmr., Trinidad, Sept., 1894; also J.P. and mag. and regisr. of births and deaths for waters of the col.; coroner for Gulf of Paria; mem. of quarantine bd., and shipping master, etc.

SAUVAGE, DANIEL.—Govt. pilot and asst. port offr., Seychelles, Feb., 1894, and port offr., May, 1897.

SAVAGE, W. D.—Apptd. bookkeeper, funds dept., treasy., O.R.C., June, 1888.

SAXTON, GEORGE SHADWELL.—Ed. at Clifton Coll.; writer, Caylon civ. ser., 1878; pol. mag. Haputale, 1887; appt. gov't. agent, Mannar, 1887; Chilaw, 1888; dist. judge, Tangalla, 1890; apptd. gov't. agent, Matale, 1890; Matara, 1890; Kalutara, 1902; gov't. agent, Sabaragamuwa, 1902.

SAYER, W. F.—Ed. Univ. Coll. Schi., Lond.; solr., 1879; bar. and solr. in W. Australia, 1891; sec. law dept., Mar., 1891; ag. comsnr. of titles, Mar., 1899; atty.-gen., 1901; parly. draftsman, 1902; crown solr., Dec., 1902; atty.-gen., 1904.

SCANLEN, THE HON. SIR THOMAS CHARLES, K.C.M.G. (1884).—B. 1834; mem. house of assem., Cape, since 1869; dep. sheriff for Cradock, 1875-66; J.P. for Cradock, May, 1869; mem. of the divisional coun. of Cradock, 1867-77; comsnr. and chmn. of the municipality of Cradock, 1870-77; apptd. by sup. ct. examr. for admission of attorneys and notaries, May, 1887; mem. of the exec. coun., May, 1881; atty.-gen. and premier, May, 1881, to June, 1882; col. sec. and premier, July, 1882, to May, 1884; proceeded to England to negotiate loan for pub. wks., Oct., 1883; as a priv. mem., carried through the Executors and Trustees Accounts Act, 1873; Titles Registration and Derelict Lands Act, 1881; prepared and carried during term of office, General Loans Act, 1881; Postal Act, 1882; Lands Clauses Act, 1882; Municipal Act, 1882; Police Regulation Act, 1882; Aliens' Naturalisation Act, 1883; Public Health Act, 1883; Liquor Licensing Act, 1883; legal adviser, Rhodesia, 1894; legal adviser, Rhodesia Administrative Staff, 1895.

SCARTE, WILLIAM BAIN.—Dep. min. of agricnl. and statistics, Canada, Dec., 1895; dep. commnr. of patents, Mar., 1897.

SCHOLITZ, CLERKE BURTON.—Comsnr., Lichtenburg, Transvaal, 1877; lieut., Bechuana-land field force on Sir C. Warren's staff; mem. of commn. on Stellaland claims, 1886; ch. clk. and asst. mag., Vrijburg, 1888; R.M., Kuruman, 1889.

SCHOMBURGK, OTTO HEINRICH.—Ck., engrn.-in-chief's office, S. Aust., Jan., 1874; ck., ch. sec.'s office, Aug., 1877; ck., regisr.-gen. of deeds office., July, 1880; ck., sheriff's office, Nov., 1882; dep. sheriff, 1891; also returning offr. W. Adelaide, Jan., 1893, to June, 1902; sheriff, July, 1903; also Commonwealth electoral offr., for the state of S. Aust., Aug., 1903; major, comdg. field batt. of artillery (retired).

SCHOOLES, HENRY RAWLINS PIPON.—Ed. Marl., called to the bar, Mid. Tem., Hilary, 1873; admitted to bar, Leeward Is., May, 1873; mem. for Sandy Point legis. assem. of St. Kitts, Mar., 1874, to Apl., 1876; ag. atty.-gen., Leeward Is., Apl. to Sept., 1876; re-elected mem. for Sandy Point, Jan., 1877; mem. of new legis. coun. of St. Kitts, 1879, and elected by the legis. coun. as sen. mem. for St. Kitts of fed. coun. of the Lee-ward Is.; June, 1880, atty.-gen., Br. Honduras; June, 1881, apptd. provisionally as ch. just. of Br. Honduras; atty.-gen., Grenada, Apl., 1883; ditto, Jamaica, 1896.

SCHREIBER, COLLINGWOOD, C.M.G. (1893).—B. 1831; emigrated from England, 1852; entered service of Hamilton and Toronto Rly., and became asst. engrn., 1852; suptding. engrn. of wks., N. Rly. of Canada, 1860-64; div. engrn., Nova Scotia govt. service, on Truro and Picton Rly., 1864-5; survey engrn., Dominion govt. service, on inter-col. rly., 1886; suptding. engrn., N. Brunswick E. Rly., 1869-71; ditto, inter-col. railway, 1871-3; ch. engrn. of govt. railways in operation, 1873-8; also gen. man., 1878-80; also engrn.-in-chief, Canadian Pacific Rly., 1880; now engrn.-in-chief, govt. rlys. and dep. min. of rlys. and canals.

SCHREINER, THE HON. W. P., C.M.G. (1890), K.C.—B. 1857; ed. S. A. Coll., Cape town, Camb. Univ., and London; advoc. of sup. ct., Cape, 1882; legal adviser to high commr., 1887-93; atty.-gen. in Mr. Rhodes's ministry, 1893; mem. of Jamieson Raid Comtee.; premier and col. sec., 1898-1900.

SCOFFHAM, W. H.—Apptd., after compet. exam., ck. of the 2nd div. of the civ. ser., and assigned to census office, 20th Feb., 1901; transf'd. to C.O., 17th Dec., 1902.

SONCE, HERBERT W.—Trin. Coll., Camb.; B.A. math., tripos, 1886; M.A. 1897; asst. master, Faversham Gram. Schi.; Godolphin Schi., Hamersmith, and Grocers' Co.'s Schi., Hackney, 1887 to 1893; asst. mr., Queen's Coll., Br. Guiana, Apr., 1893; asst. inspr. of schls., July, 1895; ag. inspr., May to Nov., 1898; June to Nov., 1900; July, 1902, to Apl., 1903; inspr. of schls. and off. visitor of Onderneeming Indust. Schi., Apl., 1903; mem. bd. of agric. for educntl. matters; examr. for prelim. exam. for govt. clerical serv.

SCOTT, J. H.—Mag., Tembuland, Aug., 1876; capt. in Tembu levies, Sept., 1877; ag. ch. mag., Tembuland, Apr. to July, 1878; ch. clk., native affairs dept., Oct., 1878; sec. to atty.-gen., on special duty to N. Border during war there, Feb. to Apr., 1879; ag. special commnr., N. Border, May to July, 1879; special commnr. and special mag. of N. Border, July, 1879; res. commnr., Pondoland, July, 1888.

SCOTT, RALPH.—B.A. Lond. Univ.; cadet, S.S., Nov., 1895; ag. collr. of land rev., Singapore, Mar., 1897; passed final exam. in Malay, Sept., 1897; ag. dist. offr., Malacca, Sept., 1897; confirmed, Apl., 1898; apptd. to Cl. IV., Jan., 1903; ag. dist. offr., Dingdings, Apl., 1903.

SCOTT, THE HON. RICHARD WILLIAM, K.C.—Called to the bar of Upper Canada, 1884; created a Q.C., 1867; sat in the legis. assem. of Canada from 1867 to 1873, and while there carried the Separate School Act of Upper Canada; returned to the Ontario assem. at confedn., 1867; ret. on his entrance into the Dominion Govt., Nov., 1873; called to the senate, Mar., 1874; was speaker of the Ontario assem. from 7th to 21st Dec., 1871; mem. of exec. coun. and commnr. of crown lands for same prov., from later date until Nov., 1873, when sworn of the Queen's privy coun.; S. of S. of Canada, Jan., 1874; ret. on resignation of Mackenzie govt., Oct., 1878; is now a senator; was the framer of the Canada Temperance Act, known as the Scott Act; joined Sir W. Laurier's govt. as S. of S., June, 1896.

SCOTT, ROBT.—Actnt. to director, army telegraphs, O.R.C., July, 1900; asst. acctnt., dept. of posts and telegraphs, Aug., 1902.

SCOTT, WALTER.—Apptd., after compet. exam., ck. of the lower (now 2nd) div. of the civ. ser., and assigned to the C.O., 22nd Jan., 1883; promoted to higher grade, 2nd div., 3rd Nov., 1896.

SCROGGIE, J. A.—Apptd. 1st ck., treasy., O.R.C., 20th May, 1900.
SCROGGS, Lieut. Harold Chas., R.N.—Harbour mast. and supt. of merc. marine, Mauritius, 23rd June, 1903.

SEALY, A.—Pol. mag. of dist. B, Barbados, Sept., 1873.

SEALY, Frank Dean.—Supernum. clk., imigrn. dept., Br. Guiana, Jan., 1884; 4th class clk., Apr., 1891; 3rd class, Jan., 1893; has acted as ch. clk.; 2nd class clk., Apr., 1895; ag. imigrn. agt., 1896 and 1898.

SEALY, Gordon Courland Miller.—Clk. to the atty.-gen., Tobago, Jan., 1882; clk. in col. sec.'s dept., 1883; acted as confid. clk. to the admstr. and clk. of couns., 1883 to 1886; 3rd clk., surg.-gen.'s dept., Br. Guiana, 1887; 2nd clk., 1887; has acted as ch. clk.

SEALY, Herbert Hamilton.—Confid. clk. to gov., and to exec. and legis. couns., Tobago, Jan., 1878; ag. audr. and regist. of deeds and of the sup. cts. from Apr. to May, 1882, and June, 1882, to Feb., 1883; ag. pol. mag., Windward dist., Oct., 1883, to Jan., 1884; is a J.P.

SEALY, J. Ernest Cameron.—2nd clk., audit and registry dept., Tobago, Feb., 1888; clk. to commrs. and financial bd., Nov., 1890, and Oct., 1893; sec. to bd. of educn., Sept., 1892; ch. clk. treas., June, 1893; postmtr. of Tobago, Dec., 1895.

SEARCY, Arthur.—Boarding offr., cust., S. Aust., 1873; clk., cust., 1874; clk., audit off., 1875; clk., cust., 1876; tide inspr. and measurer of ships, cust., 1889; correspdg. clk., cust., and sec., marine bd., 1890; ag. dep. comsurr. of taxes and stamps, 1891; correspdg. clk., cust., and sec., marine bd., 1891; sec., cust., and sec., marine bd., 1894; dep. comsurr. of taxes and stamps, 1896; comsurr. of ditto, 1897; president, marine bd., 1902; also inspr. of kerosine, 1902; also comsurr. of trade marks and regist. of copyrights, 1904.

SEARLE, H. L.—Served in 12th Sudanese Egyptian army, medal and clasp, Khedive's star and clasp; apptd. to Royal Niger Co.'s constab., 1892; took part in the expeds. of 1892-3; apptd. to Niger Coast Protectorate force, Sept., 1893; present at Brass River expedit., 1895 (med. and clasp); Cross River expedit., Aug., 1895; Qua Iho expedit., 1895; Benin City expedit., 1897 (clasp); apptd. collr. of customs and postmtr.-gen. Southern Nigeria, Feb., 1900; Aro expedit., 1901-2 (medal with clasp).

SEATON, G. L.—Apptd., after exam., 3rd cl. mess., C.O., 17th May, 1899; 2nd cl., 18th Feb., 1900; King's mess., 10th June, 1904.

SECCOMBE, G. S., L.R.C.P. (Lond.), M.R.C.S. (Eng.), 1874.—Mem. Medico-Psychological Assoc.; sen. asst. med. offr. and dep. med. supt. of Caterham Asylum, England, 1874; med. supt. of lun. asyl., and med. offr., roy. gaol, Trinidad, Sept., 1882.

SEDDON, The Right Hon. Richard J., P.C. (1897).—B. 1845; premier of N. Zealand, 1893; represented the col. in London in the Diamond Jubilee, 1897.

SEDGEWICK, Robert, K.C.—Dep. min. of just. and solr. of Indian aff airs, Canada, 1888; now a puisne judge, sup. ct.

SEE, The Hon. Sir John, K.C.M.G. (1902).—B. 1845; mem. legis. assem., N.S.W.; treas. in Dibbs's ministry, 1891-4; ch. sec. in Sir W. Lyne's ministry, 1899; premier, 1901.

SEIGNORET, C. A.—Supernumerary treas., Dominica, 1890; sec. to special yaws comm., Mar., 1891, to Sept., 1892; ch. clk., regist.'s office and clk. pub. market, 1892; asst. sec. to Sir R. Hamilton during his inquiry in Dominica, 1893; govt. offr. treasy., 1895; sec. bd. of health and quarantine, 1895; ag. clk., admstr.'s office and exec. coun., 1895; ag. treas., Dominica, July, 1901.

SEIGNORET, G. B.—Clk. to postmr., Dominica, 1889; govt. offr., treasy., 1893; ch. clk., regist.'s off., 1895; ag. postmr., 1896-7; clk. govt. offr., Roseau, 1897; govt. offr., treasy., 1901.

SELBORNE, 2nd Earl of (creat. 1882), Viscount Wolmer, Baron Selborne (U.K.), P.C. (1900), The Rt. Hon. Wm. Waldegrave Palmer, B. 1859; ed. at Winchester and at Univ. Coll., Oxford; B.A. (1st cl. hist.), 1882; asst. priv. sec. to Mr. Childers, Chanc. of Excheq., 1882-85; was mem. of parlmt. for E. Hants, 1885-92, and for W. Edinburgh City, 1892-95; succeeded his father, 1895; Under S. of S. for Cols., June, 1895; chmn. Pacific cable comttee., 1896; mem. of Pacific cable comttee., 1899; first lord of the admiralty, Nov., 12th, 1900.

SELBY-LOWNDES, R. C. W.—Ed. at I. of Wight Coll. and Tamworth Coll.; served in B.S.A. pol. during Mashonaland rebellion, 1896-7; chartered company's civil serv., 1898-1900; served during S. Africa war, Rhodesia regt., Rhodesian field force, and French's scouts, 1900-1902 (medals: Mashonaland, 1897, Queen's medal, S. A. war, 4 clasps, King's medal, 2 clasps).

SELLS, H. C., B.A. (Oxon.).—Cadet, S. Sttlms., Oct., 1897; ag. priv. sec. to gov., Nov., 1898, to Nov., 1899; ag. 4th mag., Singapore, Jan., 1900; passed fin. exam. in Malay, Apr., 1900; ag. dist. offr., prov. Well., May, 1901; supt., money order branch and govt. savings bank, Sing., May, 1902; head of Malay coll., Malacca, July, 1904.

SELWYN, Alfred Richard Cecil, LL.D., F.R.S., F.G.S., C.M.G. (1886).—B. 1824; on the geol. survey of Gt. Brit., 1845-52; dir., geol. survey, Victoria, 1853-68; dir., geol. and nat. hist. survey, Canada, 1869-95.

SEMPER, D. H.—Clk. to atty.-gen., Leeward Islands, 1893; dep. coroner for dist. B., Oct., 1898; ag. Federal treas., Oct., 1902; fed. treas., Mar., 1903; acted as clk., leg. coun., Antigua, Dec., 1902; ditto, ex. coun., Montserrat, Mar., 1903.

SEN, Nirmal Chandria.—Cadet, S. Sttlms., 27th Nov., 1903.

SENEVIRATNE, Alexander de Alwis.—Mem. of legis. coun., Ceylon; advoc. of the sup. ct.; mem. mun. coun., Colombo, and coun. of legal educn.; chmn. Ceylon national assoc.

SENIOR, Bernard.—Clk. to bindry. coman. (Redistribution of Seats Act), 1884; attached to Scotol educn. dept., 1885, and again 1888; priv. sec. to Sir F. R. Sandford, under-secr. for Scotland, 1887; 1st class clk., col. sec.'s office, G. Coast, 1888; local auditor, Lagos, Aug., 1889; ditto, G. Coast, Dec., 1889; ditto, Br. Bechuana land, Feb., 1894; ditto, Cyprus, 1895; and-gen., O. R. C., Sep., 1902; is also chrmn. of tender bd.; ag. col. treas., O. R. C., from 12th Aug., 1902; aud. gen., Oct., 1902; ag. col. treas., 12th Aug., 1903, to 15th Feb., 1904; M.L.C., May, 1904; author of "A Guide to the examination of Government Accounts in Cyprus."

SETH, Arathoon.—Called to the bar, Lincoln's Inn, June, 1893; Hindustani interp., magistracy, Hong Kong, Feb., 1868, to Dec., 1869 (in the serv. of the P. & O. Co. in the interim); re-entered magistracy as 3rd clk., Sept., 1872; 2nd clk., Sept., 1873; 1st clk., Feb., 1875; clk. of couns., and ch. clk., C.S.O., Feb., 1881; valuer under the "Rating Ord., 1875," 25th June, 1881, to 19th Mar., 1883; J.P., Jan., 1882; supt. of the opium revenue, Aug., 1883, to Feb., 1885;
ditto, imports and exports, June to Oct., 1887; sec. to bd. under "Taipinghain resumption order," 1894-1895 (recd. thanks of govt.), sec. to insani-
tary properties comsn., July, 1896; ag. deputy land offr., Nov., 1894, to Jan., 1895; ditto, Mar.,
1895, to Nov., 1896; dep. regisr. and appraiser,
sup. ct., and comnr. for oaths, Mar., 1895; comnr. for taking acknowledgments of married
women, Oct., 1896; sec. squatter's bd.; offl. recvr.
in bankruptcy, Mar., 1895, to Nov., 1896; ag. asst.
regisr.-gen., July to Sept., 1897; ag. regisr., sup.
ct.; ag. land offr.; ag. regisr. of companies; offl.
admstr., and offl. trustee, 15th Dec., 1898, to 26th
Jan., 1900; ag. regisr., sup. ct., 1903-04; con-
firmed, 1904.

SETH, G. G.—B.A., Calcutta; cadet, S. S.,
Nov., 1901; ag. sheriffl, Singapore, Jan., 1903;
passed final exam. in Malay, Jan., 1903; ag. 3rd
mag., Singapore, 5th Jan., 1904; ag. dep. regisr.,
sup. ct., Singapore, July, 1904.

SHAND, CHAS. ARTHUR.—Mem. local as-
sembly, Antigua, 1876-1891; ditto, federal coun-
1877-1891; J.P., Antigua, 1885; mem. ex. coun.,
Antigua, 1887; chrmn. P.L. guardians and of
several local boards, Antigua; dist. mag., Nevis,
Feb., 1903; and offl. mem. leg. coun., St.
Kirits-Nevis.

SHARE, HAMNET HOLDITCH.—Entered Royal
Navy, 1880; served in H.M.S. "Tourmaline"
and numerous other ships (Egypt, medal, 1882,
and Khedive's Bronze Star); sec. to Comdr-in-
Chief, Pacific station, 1899-1900; ditto, Australia
station, 1901-1903; priv. sec. to gov. of N. S.
Wales, May, 1903.

SHARPE, SIR ALFRED, K.C.M.G. (1903), C.B.
(1897).—B. 1853; H.M.'s vice-consul, Nyasaland,
14th Feb., 1891; ditto, for territories under
British influence North of the Zambesi, 18th
Feb., 1893; consul for same territories, 1st Feb.,
1894; ag. comnr. and consul-gen. at Zomba,
7th May, 1894 to 3rd May, 1895; given rank of
deputy comnr., 1st Apl., 1896; and again acted
as comnr. and consul-gen., 16th Apl., 1896 to
14th July, 1897; comnr. and consul-gen., for
territories under Brit. infi. N. of Zambesi, 15th
July, 1897; recd. Jubilee medal, 1897; comnr.,
commdr.-in-chief, and consul-gen., B. Cent.
Africa Prot., 1st Jan., 1902; recd. Coronation
medal, 1902.

SHARPE, W. S., C.M.G. (1900).—B. 1860;
capt. 4th batt. R.I. Rifles, 1893; major, Oct.,
1903; instr., Sierra Leone frontier force, Mar.,
1894; 3rd comnr. to Anglo-French bdry.
coman. and delimited frontier from Atlantic coast
to Little Mola River, 1896; dist. comnr., Karene
dist., Jan., 1897; F.R.G.S., and J.P. for the col.;
transfd. to N. Nigeria as asst. res., Dec., 1900;
apptd. 2nd class res., Oct., 1901.

SHAW, CAPT. BERNARD VIDAL.—Late capt.
rifle brigade; priv. sec. to dir. of crim. investig.,
London; comnr. of pol., Capetown, 1882 to 1888
(office abolished); visiting mag., Breakwater con-
vict station (Cape); author of "Epitome of the
Criminal Law of the Cape;" sub-imigr. agt.,
Br. Guiana, 1889; supt. H.M.'s penal stintm.,
Massarum, Jan., 1894; stip. mag., 1897.

SHAW, COURTENAY.—Clk. in off. of sec. to
Transvaal adminstrn., Mar., 1901; ag. priv.
sec. to ditto, Mar. to June, 1902; priv. sec. to
col. sec., Transvaal, July, 1902.

SHAWE, HENRY BENJAMIN.—Clk. at Clan-
william, Cape Colony, 12th May, 1883; col. secy.'s
off., Cape Town, Dec., 1883; sen. examnr. of
acctnts., 14th Apl., 1890; chief ditto, 1st July,
1894; acctnt., 10th July, 1895; acctntg. offr.,
31st Mar., 1899; ch. clk. and acctng. offr., 1st
Mar., 1901; ag. under col. sec., 1st Apl. to 30th
Sept., 1901; asst. under col. sec., 1st Apl., 1902.

SHEA, THE HON. SIR AMBROSE, K.C.M.G.
(1883).—B. 1818; mem. of assem., Newfoundland,
1860-87; deleg. to Washington on reciprocity
treaty, 1854; speaker, 1855-61; organised plan
for water supply for St. John's, 1860; deleg. to
London on French fishery treaty, 1861; deleg.
to Quebec on confederation of provs., 1864; and
on trade convention, 1865; comnr. at fishery
exhib., London, 1883; deleg. to Washington on
fishery treaty, 1885; deleg. to col. confce., 1887;
gov., Bahamas, July, 1887-94.

SHEA, THE HON. SIR E. D., KT. BACH. (1902).
—Col. sec. and clk. of coun., Newfoundland, Jan.,
1874; cashier of savings bank, and pres. of legis.
coun., Feb., 1886.

SHEA, THE HON. GEORGE.—M.H.A., Ferry-
land (Newfd.), 1889-93; again in 1897; mem.
exec. coun. (without portfolio), 1897; mem. of
treasy. bd., 1898.

SHELFORD, SIR WILLIAM, K.C.M.G. (1904),
C.M.G. (1901), M.I.C.E.—B. 1834; consulting
engnr. for railways to the Crown agents for
the cols.

SHENTON, THE HON. SIR GEORGE, KT. BACH.
(1893), J.P.—B. 1842; mem. of the legislature
of W. Australia, 1870-74, 1875-90; on the intro-
duction of respon. govt., col. sec. in the first
ministry formed by Sir John Forrest; pres. of
the legis. coun., Oct., 1892 on the death of Sir
T. Campbell, Bart.; is senior mem. of the metro-
politan prov.; has been mayor of Perth on
eleven different occasions.

SHEPPARD, WALTER SYDNEY.—B.A., M.B.,
B. Ch., Cantab., civil surg. in charge of H.M.'s
troops, N.E. dist., Eng., May, 1898 to May, 1899;
spec. plague med. offr., India, May, 1899 to Nov.,
1900; house surg., gen. hosp., Singapore, 19th
Nov., 1900; super. col. surg., S. Stltms., 1st
Mar., 1901.

SHEPSTONE, H.C., C.M.G. (1895).—Priv. sec.
to the lieut.-gov., Natal, 1857; clk. to exec.
coun., 1863; Indian imigr. agt. and J.P., 1864;
R.M. and admstr. of native law, Alfred co., 1870;
ditto, Durban co., 1878; acted as sec. to Mr.
Justice Phillips, C.M.G., on special service to
Barbados, 1876; served on the staff of Sir
Theophilus Shepstone, K.C.M.G., H.M.'s special
comnr. in S. Africa, 1877; sec. for nativo affairs,
Transvaal, July, 1877; attended Cetywayo on his
visit to England, 1882; sec. for nativo affairs,
Natal, 1884; ret., 1883.

SHEPSTONE, JOHN WESLEY, C.M.G. (1888).
—B. 1827; July, 1846, govt. interp., Natal; July,
1847, accompanied Capt. Kyle on special mission to
Zulu king; Dec., 1850, accompanied Capt. Gordon
on special mission to Pondos; Oct., 1851, interp.
to recorder and mag.'s offices; Dec., 1851, asst.
R.M., Pietermaritzburg co.; Aug., 1852, R.M.,
Lower Umvoti, and govt. agt., Noniti country, and
J.P.; 1857, commanded native forces against Chief
Usidoi and tribe, and against Chief Matyana
and tribe; Nov., 1858, supt. of the cultivation
of cotton; Apr., 1861, ag. sec. for nativo affairs
and judicial assessor; July, 1861, commanded a
native force in the Fort Buckingham expdn.;
May, 1862, ag. R.M., Inanda div.; Aug., 1863,
asst. R.M., Pietermaritzburg co.; ag. R.M.,
Umvoti co., Sept., 1867; May, 1874, comnr.,
Klip River and Weenen counties; July, 1874, ag.
sec. for nativo affairs and judicial assessor; Oct.,
1874, J.P. for the col.; Sept., 1876, sec. for nativo
affairs and mem. exec. and legis. couns.; Mar.,
1878, mem. of the bndry. comsn.; Dec., 1878, delivered ultimatum to Zulu delega. at Lower Drift, Tugela; Aug., 1879, accompanied Sir Garnet Wolseley to arrange the settlement of Zululand; mentioned in despatches; Dec., 1882, Br. comsnr., Zululand; Jan., 1884, judge, native high ct.; ret., 1896.

SHEPSTONE, THEOPHILUS, C.M.G. (1890).—B. 1843; was in command of a Basuto regt. in the Zulu war; mem. of Natal legis. coun. until 1887; counsellor with Umbandeen, King of Swaziland, 1887-91.

SHERIFF, PERCY MUSGRAVE CRESSWELL.—Called to the bar, Mid. Temple, June, 1892; admitted to the bar of B. Hond., 1893; of Jamaica, 1895; ag. dist. comsnr., Belize, for six months in 1898; apptd. mag. and coroner, So. dist., Grenada, 1900; visiting just. of prisons, 1900; chairman of St. George's Road Board, 1901; ag. mem. legia. coun., June, 1902; ag. ch. just. and prov. mem. of ex. coun., St. Vincent, Dec., 1902; admtd. govt. and acted as col. sec. and treas., Aug., 1903; ch. just., St. Vincent, Oct., 1903; appt., confirmed, Dec., 1903; M.L.C., Apr., 1904.

SHIELS, THE HON. WILLIAM.—Atty. gen., Victoria, 1891; premier and treas., 1892-3.

SHIPWAY, WALTER ROBERT.—Apptd., after compet. exam., 2nd div. clk., and assigned to C. O., Dec., 1898.

SHOLL, L. H., I.S.O. (1903).—B. 1844; clk., P.W. office, S. Australia, July, 1858; clk., waterwks. dept., Jan., 1859; clk., audit office, Sept., 1868; ch. clk., Jan., 1872; ch. clk. and acctnt., treasy., July, 1874; acctnt. and receiver of rev., treasy., July, 1876; cashier and acctnt., treasy., July, 1879; under-treas., July, 1883 under-sec. and govt. statist., May, 1890; also clk. of exec. coun., July, 1894.

SHOLL, R. A., I.S.O. (1903).—Probation clk., P.O., W. Australia, 1863; 3rd class clk., 1864; 2nd class clk., 1869; ch. clk., 1873; ch. clk. and acctnt., treasy., 1879; ditto, P.O., 1881; postm. gen., 1889; also lieut. metropolitan rifles (W.A.), 1875; capt., 1883; capt.-comdt., 1888; ret., 1904.

SHORT, EDWARD MORRISON DE COUBOY.—Ceylon writer, 1878; pol. mag., 1883; asst. to govt. agt., S. prov., 1886; asst. collr. of cust., and landing surrv., cust., Galle, May, 1886; ag. asst. govt. agt., Mannar, Jan., 1889; Hambantota, Sept., 1889; Kegalla, May, 1890; Vavuniya and Mullaitivu, Dec., 1890; Kalutara, Apr., 1894; Chilaw, Dec., 1895; Vavuniya, Apr., 1896; Matara, Nov., 1897; asst. govt. agt., Matale, Jan. 1900; Nuwara Eliya, 15 Aug., 1900; ag. pol. mag., Galle, Oct., 1890; dist. judge, Matara, Feb., 1892; asst. govt. agt., Matale, 16th Jan. 1900; ditto, Nuwara Eliya, 15th Aug., 1900.

SHOWERS, EDWARD MELIAN.—Served in Bengal police, Feb., 1867 to Sept., 1901; comsnr. of pol., Transvaal, 8th Nov., 1901.

SIDNEY, T. S., M.A.—Ed. Harvard, and Trin. Hall, Camb.; called to the bar, Mid. Temp., June, 1885; enrolled adv. to high ct. of Madras, 1894; apptd. dist. comsnr., Epe, Lagos, Jan., 1901.

SIERRA LEONE, BISHOP OF, Rt. REV. EDMUND HENRY ELWIN, M.A., Merton Coll., Oxon, cur. of St. Peter-le-Bailey, Oxford, 1894-6; chaplain at Fourah Bay Coll., S. Leone, 1896-8; principal, 1898-1901; chapln. to Bp. of S. Leone, 1898-1901; Bishop of Sierra Leone, 1901.

SIMPSON, GEORGE.—Inspr. of schls., Bermuda, 1880; also inspr. of dockyard schls.

SINCKLER, E. G.—Entered col. sec.'s office, Barbados, Nov., 1874; acted as clk. to lieut.-gov., 1878; 2nd clk. corrpdce. branch, col. sec.'s office, 1879; ag. asst. clk. to Gov. W. Robinson, 1889; 1st clk., record branch, col. sec.'s office, and clk. courts of ordinary and error, Jan., 1883; ag. ch. clk., 1886; comsnr. of census, 1891; ch. clk. to judges, 1892; J.P., Oct., 1892; ag. regnr., friendly socs., June, 1893; ag. sen. pol. mag., Bridgetown, and dist. A, Aug. to Oct., 1893; ag. pol. mag. and judge, dist. B, Sept. to Oct., 1894; has acted several times as coroner, dist. A; ag. pol. mag. and judge, dist. F, July, 1896, to Jan., 1897; ag. pol. mag. judge, and coroner, dist. B, Sept. to Oct., 1897; ag. pol. mag. and judge, dist. D, Mar. to Apr., 1898; ag. coroner, St. Michael, 1898 (at time of hurricane), and has repeatedly acted as such; ag. pol. mag. and judge, dist. B, 1899; ag. pol. mag. dist. A, Feb., 1900; ag. comsnr. of probate, May to Nov., 1900; ag. pol. mag., dist. A, July, 1900, to Sept., 1901; pol. mag. and judge, dist. E Oct., 1901.

SINCLAIR, WM.—Clk., stores dept., L. and N.W. rly., Jan., 1863; stores auditor, July, 1873; rly. storekeeper, Midland system, Cape govt. rly., Aug., 1878; ch. rly. storekeeper, Jan., 1886; storekeeper, C.S.A.R., 1904.

SINGAPORE, LABUAN, AND SARAWAK. 3rd BISHOP OF LABUAN, THE RIGHT REV. GEORGE FREDERICK HOSE, D.D.—Ed. St. John's Coll., Camb.; B.A., 1861; M.A., 1867; D.D., 1881; curate of Roxton with Great Barford, Beds., 1861-65; curate of Trinity, St. Marylebone, London, 1865-67; col. chaplain, Malacca, Nov., 1867; ditto, Singapore, Feb., 1874; regnr. of the diocese of Labuan, Apr., 1874; archdeacon of Singapore, Dec., 1874; bishop of Singapore, Labuan, and Sarawak, 1881.

SIVEWRIGHT, THE HON. SIR JAMES, K.C.M.G. (1892), C.M.G. (1880).—B. 1848; gen. man. of telegraphy, C. of Good Hope, Apr., 1878; ret., 1885; M.L.A., 1889; mem. of Rhodes's ministry without portfolio, July, 1900, and subsequently as comnr. of crown lands and pub. wks.; resig., 1893; resumed office, Jan., 1896.

SKEEN, G. J. A.—Extra asst. govt. printer, Ceylon, 1869; asst. govt. printer, 1872; govt. printer, 1881.

SKEETE, ELLIOT L., B.A., Durham, 1883.—Asst. to supt. bot. station, Barbados, Sept., 1890; ag. supt., Dec., 1890, to Jan., 1891; ch. offr. reformatory, May, 1892; ag. supt. reformatory and bot. station, July to Dec., 1894, and Apr. to May, 1896; and other occasions.

SKERRITT, CHRISTOPHER MARTIN.—Supernumerary clk., regnr. and provost marshal's office, Dominica, July to Dec., 1891, and Feb. to Sept., 1892; asst. clk. to govt. offr., Roseau, Sept., 1892, to Mar., 1893; aid waiter, treasy., Aug. to Oct., 1893; tax collr., treasy., Nov., 1893, to Apr., 1894; asst. clk., tax dept., treasy., 1895; asst. to admstr., Jan. to Mar., 1896; 2nd clk., regnr. and prov. marshal's off., Dominica, Mar., 1896 to Dec., 1899; 1st clk., Jan., 1901; is a comnr. to admstr. oaths, Dominica; and supt. of pub. cemetery; has held numerous "acting" appointments.

SKINNER, WM., M.A.—Ed. Bedford gram. schl.; scholar St. Catherine's Coll., Camb. B.A. (math. tripes), 1882; M.A., Oct., 1886; headmr., Govt. gram. schl., Dominica, Dec., 1892.

SLATER, A. R.—Ed. at King Ed. schl., Birmingham, and Emm. coll., Camb. (B.A. 1897); cadet, Ceylon, Nov., 1898; extra offr., asst. govt. agent, W. P., Aug., 1899; 2nd asst., P.M.G., Mar., 1900; ag. 2nd asst. col. sec., Dec., 1901; on spec. duty at camp for prisoners of war.
Diyatalawa, July, 1902; ag. 2nd asst. col. sec., Jan., 1903; clk. leg. coun., May, 1904.

SLATTERY, THE HON. T. M.—Mem. legis. assem., N.S. Wales; sec. for mines and agricul. in Dibbs's ministry, 1891-94.

SLOLEY, HERBERT CECIL.—Served in C.M.R. in campaigns against Griquas and Moirosi (medal with clasp, 1877-8-9); capt. in native contingent, Basuto war, 1880-1; mentioned in despatches; sub-instr., Cape police, 1883; ditto, Basutoland, 1884; instr., 1886; asst. commr., Basutoland, 1889; ag. res. commr., July to Dec., 1895; govt. sec., 1896.

SLYNE, D.—Barrister-at-law; Lord O'Hagan medallist and David Lynch medallist, King's Inns, Ireland; entered Imperial civ. serv., open compet., 1880; until 1900 attached successively to Inland Rev. Dept. at Dublin, Sligo, Chester, Oxford, Leicester, Birmingham, Dublin, Dundee, and Birmingham; apptd. supervising excise offr., Trinidad, 1900; ag. receiver-gen., May, 1902; receiver-gen., Feb., 1903.

SMALLWOOD, HENRY ARMSTRONG.—Entered navy, 1885; on board H.M.S. "Victoria" at time of disaster, June, 1893; asst. commr., Colo West, and stip. mag., Apr., 1894; ag. stip. mag., Ba and Yasawa, Apr., 1896; 2nd clk., col. sec.'s office, and priv. sec. to gov. Fiji, Apr., 1896; ag. sec. to W. Pac. high comm., May, 1897, to May, 1898; stip. mag., Savu Savu and Taviuni, Jan., 1899; island treas., Cyprus, Mar., 1900.

SMART, ARCHIBALD WM.—Clk., dept. of trade and cust., Melbourne, 1863; landing waiter, 1868; landing survr., 1890; senior ditto, 1893; collr. of cust., Victoria, and regis. of shipping, Melbourne, 1903; ch. Commonwealth survr., 1903.

SMARTT, JAMES A.—Alderman of Brandon, Manitoba, 1882-84; mayor, 1886-87; mem. judicial bd., 1886; mem. of prov. legislature, 1886; min. of pub. wks., 1888; dep. min. of the interior of Canada, Apr., 1897; dept. supt.-gen. of Indian affairs, July, 1897.

SMARTT, CAPT. J. P. (3rd Batt., South Lancs. Regt.)—Public wks. and roads dept., G. Coast, 1893-96; local auditor, N. C. Prot. (now S. Nigeria), Oct., 1896; chief asst. treas., Dec., 1901; ag. treas., Dec., 1901, to June, 1902, and June to Dec., 1903; lieut. G. C. rifle volrs., May, 1893; capt., Nov., 1893; ag. adjt., May to Nov., 1893; ag. comdt., Oct., 1896, to Mar., 1896; attached for duty with Niger C. Protec. force, May to July, 1897, May and Aug., 1900; ag. treas., So. Nigeria, June to Dec., 1903, and in Sept., 1904; served with expdt. Benin territories, Apr. and May, 1899; mentd. in desps., medal and clasp; bronze medal R. Hum. Soc., 1887.

SMEETON, S. P., I.S.O. (1905).—B. 1842; extra clk. in office of S. of S. for Cols., June, 1862; 1st class clk. in col. sec.'s office, Jamaica, June, 1870; regis.-gen. of births, deaths, and marriages, 8th Feb., 1878; suptd. the taking of census of Jamaica, 1881 and 1891; dep. keeper of records (on amalgamation of registration and record depts.), May, 1899; nom. mem. of comm. to inquire into marriage and regis. laws, May, 1903.

SMITH, ALLAN F.—Clk. in P.O., Bermuda, 1879; clk., col. sec.'s office, 1886; asst. col. sec., 1895; col. postmr., 1896; ag. col. sec., July and Aug., 1899, and from May, 1900, to July, 1901.

SMITH, SIR C. ABERCROMBIE, KNT. BACH. (1903).—M.A. (Camb. and Glas.), fellow of St. Peter's Coll., Camb., 2nd wrangler and 2nd Smith's prize-man, 1888, &c.; mem. of the house of assem., Cape, 1866-75; mem. of the exec. coun., 1872; commr. of crown lands and pub. works, 1872-75; mem. of comm. under Ordinance 97, 1872-5; commr. of the sinking fund, 1872-4; mem. of the Univ. coun., 1873; chmn. of the meteorol. comm., 1874; comptroller and audr.-gen., 1875; chmn. of the tender bd., 1875; mem. of the surety bd., 1875-86; vice-chancellor, Cape Univ., 1877-9; commr., civ. ser. exams. bd., 1886; chairman, 1887; ret., 1904.

SMITH, C. A. JEFFREY.—Apprentice, pub. wks. dept., Jamaica, Aug., 1870; asst. to ch. supt., 1875; 3rd class ditto, 1879; 2nd class ditto, 1881; ag. dist. engnr., W. dist., 1886; ditto, Kingston dist., 1888-9; overseer of wks., prisons dept., 1889; 1st cls. supt., pub. wks., and supt., St. Catherine waterwks., 1896; also acted on several occasions as govt. assessor, and supt. irrigation wks.

SMITH, SIR CECIL CLEMENTI, G.C.M.G. (1892), K.C.M.G. (1886), C.M.G. (1880).—B. 1840; ed. at St. Paul's Schl. and Corp. Chr. Coll., Camb.; B.A., 1862, M.A., 1868; elected student interp., Hong Kong, Mar., 1862; regr.-gen., Mar., 1865; ag. pol. mag., June, 1865; ag. col. sec., 1867; mem. of exec. coun., 1869; ag. col. sec., Feb., 1872, to Dec., 1873; treas., 1871; acted as col. sec., Oct., 1874, and also from Mar., 1875; col. sec., S. Stilmta, July, 1878; apptd. under the F.O. to be Br. commr. to settle certain marine claims at Manila, Sept., 1878, and received the thanks of H.M.'s govt.; also for services in connection with the "Nisero" case, 1884; administered govt. S.S., Mar., 1884, to Nov., 1885; lieut.-gov. and col. sec., Ceylon, Nov., 1885; gov. of S.S., 1887; also consul-gen. and high commr. for Borneo and Sarawak, 1889; ret., 1893; pres. of comm. to inquire into Trinidad riots, 1903.

SMITH, SIR CHARLES HOLLED, K.C.M.G., C.B.—B. 1846; ensign, 1863; lieut., 1869; capt., 1877; S. African war, 1879-1881; Zulu campaign; Transvaal cam.; battles of Laing's Nek, Ingogo, and Majuba Mountain; despatches, Lon. Gaz. May 8, 1881; Egypt. exped., 1882; at Ramleh, Tel-el-Mahuta; action at Kassassin; battle of Tel-el-Kebir, Lon. Gaz., Nov. 2, 1882; major (brevet), Nov., 1882; with Egyp. army, Jan., 1883, to Aug., 1892; Sudan exped., 1884-5; lieut.-col., June, 1886; col., Dec., 1888; gov.-gen., Red Sea littoral, and comdt., Suakin, Sept., 1888, to Aug., 1892; Sudan, 1888-91; action of Gamaizah, Lon. Gaz., Jan. II, 1889; occupation of Handoul, Jan., 1891; major-gen. comding Victorian mil. forces, Dec., 1894; several medals, clasps to bronze stars, and mentioned in numerous despatches.

SMITH, EDWIN MITCHELL.—Entered survey, crown lands dept., S Australia, as asst., June, 1862; cadet and jun. survr.; survr., Jan. 1869; draftman, Jan., 1874; steward and survr. of educnl. lands, Feb., 1882; ch. clk., land office, Jan., 1886; dep. survr.-gen., July, 1894; mem. of central pastoral and central lands bds.

SMITH, FRANCIS.—Ch. mag., Gambia, 1879; puisne judge, G. Coast Col., 1887.

SMITH, FRANCIS JAGOR.—M.A. Oxon.; ed. Merchant Taylors schl.; scholar, St. John's Coll., Oxford, 1892; 2nd cls. class. moda., 1894; 2nd math. mods., 1894; 2nd Lit. Hum., 1896; B.A., 1896; M.A., 1902; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Oct., 1896; attached to col. sec.'s off., 1896; office asst. to govt. agt., and deputy fiscal, Cent. Prov., Apl., 1898; commr. of requests and pol. mag., Balapitiya, Aug., 1900; ditto, Galle, June, 1901; landing survr., customs, Colombo, Dec., 1901.

SMITH, THE HON. SIR FRANCIS, KNT. (creat. 1862).—B. 1819; B.A. Lond. Univ., 1840; called to the bar, Mid. Temp., May, 1842; solr.-gen.,
SMITH, FRANK BRAYBROOKE.—Director of agric., Transvaal, and agric. adviser to the govt., Apr., 1902; M.I.C.

SMITH, FREDERICK BONHAM, I.S.O. (1903).—B. 1837; entered col. sec.'s office, Barbados, 1869; in office of gov.-in-chief of the Windward Is., 1860 to 1866; pol. mag. of Christchurch, Barbados, 1866; sen. pol. mag. of Bridgetown and St. Michael, 1873; ag. judge of the ass't. ct. of appeal, 1878 to 1880; inspr. of prisons, 1878, held with office of provost-marshal from 1882; ag. col. sec., 1879.

SMITH, FREDERICK STANLEY.—Ed. at Sherborne Coll., Eng.; called to the bar, In. Temp., Jan., 1892; ag. pol. mag., dist. "B," Barbados, Aug. to Oct., 1893; ag. pol. mag., dist. "D," Apr., 1894, to July, 1896; and from Dec., 1895, to Oct., 1896; ag. pol. mag., dist. "C," Jan. to Feb., 1897; J.P., Apr., 1897; ag. judge-ass't., ct. of appeal, Apr. to Sept., 1897; ag. pol. mag., dist. "E," Jan., 1898; ag. pol. mag., Bridgetown and dist. "A," Feb. to May, 1898; ag. pol. mag., dist. "F," Sept. to Oct., 1898; apptd. pol. mag., dist. "D," Jan., 1899; ag. pol. mag., Bridgetown and dist. "A," Nov., 1901, to Apr., 1902.

SMITH, GEORGE.—Transf'd from W.O. to ch sec.'s office, Cyprus, Nov., 1879; ch. clk., 1881; asst. to ch. sec., 1883 to 1891; clk., legis. coun., 1886 to 1891; sec. to the comteer for the representation of Cyprus at the Col. and Ind. Exhibition; ag. ch. sec., May to Oct., 1888; comsnr. of Papho, 1891; regia-gen. and mem. legis. coun., 1895.

SMITH, GEORGE.—Ed. at Galway House Schl., Leyton, Essex, and at Morden House, Greenwich; ag. dist. comsnr., Anamaboe, G. Coast, 1877; dist. comsnr. Dexcove, 1878; ditto, Palma and Leckie, Lagos, 1880; sub-collr. customs, Palma and Leckie, 1883; ch. clk. and warehouse keeper, customs, Lagos, Aug., 1889; ag. dist. comsnr., E. dist., Lagos, Mar., 1892.

SMITH, GERALD STANLEY WELLS.—Graduate Ontario business coll., Canada; supry. clk., regis.'s office, Grenada, Jan., 1890; asst. clk., post office, Mar., 1890; 4th clk., treasy., June, 1890; asst. clk., col. sec.'s office, Oct., 1890; 2nd clk., treasy., Nov., 1891; audit clk., Nov., 1897; has held numerous acting appointments.

SMITH, Lieut.-Col. Sir GERRARD, K.C.M.G. (1895).—B.1839; late lieut.-col. Roy. Scots Guards; groom-in-waiting to Her Majesty, 1883-5; M.P. for High Wycombe, 1883-5; J.P. for E. Riding of Yorkshire; gov. of W. Australia, 1895 to 1900.

SMITH, HENRY.—Joined Mauritius pol. force, Feb., 1886; inspr. of police, Seychelles, Nov., 1897.

SMITH, HENRY J.—Apptd., after exam., 3rd cl. messenger C.O., 12th Nov., 1883; 2nd cl. ditto, 1st June, 1897; Queen's mess., 1st Apr., 1898.

SMITH, JAMES ALFRED.—Apptd., after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. serv., and assigned to the C.O., Apr., 1891; promoted to higher grade, 1902.

SMITH, Jas. C.—Ch. clk. and storekr., Imperial treasy. and commissariat depts., Bahamas, June, 1876, to Aug., 1889; mem. bd. of educ., 1886 to 1892; postmr., 1889; J.P., 1890; elected mem. of Bahamas House of Assembly in 1882-89 and 96; resigned 1897; asst. postmr. gen., Sierra Leone, Dec., 1896; J.P., 1897; ag. postmr. gen., 1897, 1899, and 1900; ag. curator of intestates, S. L., from Jan., 1899, to Jan., 1900.

SMITH, JAMES PARKER, M.P.; P.C. (1904).—Ed. Winchester, and Trin. Coll., Camb. (4th wrangler and 2nd Smith's prizeman, 1877; fellow of Winchester and late fellow Trin. Coll.) called to bar. Lincoln's Inn, 1881; J.P. and D.L., Renfrewshire and co. of city of Glasgow; J.P., Lanarkshire; dir. of Union Bank of Scotland; elected for Partick div. of Lanarkshire, 1890; parly. priv. sec. to Mr. Chamberlain, 1901-3.

SMITH, SIR JOHN SMALMAN, KT. BACH (1896).—M.A., St. John's Coll., Camb.; b. 1847; called to the bar, In. Temp., 1872; special pleader Oxford circuit; puise judge, G. Coast Col., 1883; judge, Lagos, 1886; ch. just., Lagos, 1889; ret., 1896.

SMITH, LINDSAY LEA.—Acting clk. to comsnr., Turks Is., 1894, 1896, 1900, and 1903; confirmed 1st July, 1903.

SMITH, RICHARD WILLIAM, A.M.I.C.E., B.A., B.A.I.—P. W. Dept., Ceylon; ed. at the Grammar Schl., Chard, Somerset, 1874, and Dublin Univ. (Trinity College), 1875-79; employed in engineer's off., D.W.W. Rlwy., 1879; res. engrn., Wicklow Harb. works, 1880-83; asst. to Mr. J. Lanyon, Belfast (rlwys., waterworks, drainage, etc.), 1883-85; res. engr., Cleggan Harb. Works, 1885-88; asst. res. engr., St. Helier's Harb. Works (Jersey), 1888-89; aspt. P.W. Panang, S.S., 1889-92; D.E., P.W.D., Ceylon, 1892-94; ag. prov. engrn., N.W.P., 1894-97; dist. engrn. and ag. prov. engr., S.P., 1898; seconded to railway extensions staff, 1898; seconded to "Water Supply Schemes," 1898-1900; charge of Boer Camp Works, 1900; "Water Supply Schemes," 1901-02; seconded as res. engrn., proposed convict prison works, Seychelles, 1902; returned to Ceylon 13th Aug., 1902.

SMITH, ROBERT MURRAY, C.M.G. (1894).—B. 1831; agt.-gen. for Victoria in United Kingdom, 1881-86.

SMITH, HON. SYDNEY.—M.P. for Macquarie, New South Wales; postmr.-gen., Commonwealth of Australia, in Reid-Turner ministry, 1904.

SMITH, THOMAS SERCOMBE, B.A., LL.B. (Lond.).—Hong Kong cadet, 1882; attached to C.O., 1883; passed cadet, 1886; ag. asst. regist.-gen., 1886-90, except for five months as ag. pol. mag.; asst. regist. gen., 1891; called to the bar. Mid. Tem., Nov., 1893; ag. puise judge, various dates, 1895-7, and in 1900, 1901 and 1904; treas. Dec., 1896; pol. mag., July, 1898; ag. col. sec., 1898-9, and for 3 months in 1901.

SMITH, WM. EDWARD.—Employed on L. & N.W. Rly., 1872-82; asst. traffic man., Indian guaranteed rlys. (Scinde, Punjab, and Delhi), 1883-86; ag. district traffic man., Lahore and Delhi div.; gen. man., Barbados Rly., 1889; gen. and traffic man., Trinidad and Govt. Rly., Feb., 1894; received special allowance of 100/ in 1896 for reorganising rly. dept.; is a J.P.

SMITH, SIR WILLIAM FREDERICK HAYNES, K.C.M.G. (1890), C.M.G. (1887).—B. 1839; called to the bar, Mid. Tem., June, 1863; solr.-gen., Br. Guiana, Oct., 1865; atty.-gen., Oct., 1874; admstr. the govt., Apr. to Sept., 1884, and in 1887; gov., Leeward Is., Nov., 1888; gov., Bahamas, 1895; high comsnr., Cyprus, 1898-1904.

SMITH, SIR WILLIAM JAMES, KT. BACH (1896).—M.A., LL.M. Trinity Hall, Camb.; b. 1853; acted as puise judge of the G. Coast Col. from Dec. 1880, to July, 1881; puise judge of the sup. ct.
of Cyprus, 1882; ch. just., 1892; ch. just., Br. Guiana, 1898; puisne judge, sup. ct., Transvaal, 1st Mar., 1902.

SMITH, WILLIAM RAMSAY.—B.Sc., M.B., M.S., Edin.; chmn. cent. bd. of health, coroner, vaccination offr., and inspr. of anatomy, S. Australia, 1899-1903; chmn. cent. bd. of health, and coroner, 1903.

SMITH-STEINMETZ, GERARD ARCHIBALD.—Ed. at Stonyhurst coll.; cadet, Straits Settlements, Oct., 1902; in charge of S.S. emigr. depôt, S. India, June, 1904; passed final exam. in Tamil, July, 1904.

SMUTS, JOHANNES.—Ck., treasy., Cape, 1882; acted as priv. sec. to the Hon. J. Gordon Sprigg, 1885-6; to Sir H. A. Smyth, 1889; to Lieut.-Gen. H. E. Cameron, and to Sir H. Loch, 1891; sec. to Hon. J. H. Hofmeyr (Swaziland Convention), 1890; asst. despatch ck., govt. house, 1886; 2nd class clk., 1887; ag. priv. sec. to Lieut.-Gen. Cameron and to Sir H. B. Loch, 1891 to 1896; ch. clk. to high commr., 1891; acted as olk. of exec. coun., 1891 and 1896; Br. consul in Swaziland, Aug., 1896-9.

SMYLY, PHILIP CRAMPTON.—Ed. at Trin. Coll., Dub., B.A., LL.B.; called to the bar, King's Inns, Dub., 1888; LLD., 1891; Queen's advoo., S. Leone, 1896; atty.-gen., 1896.

SMYTH, C. E. OWEN, I.S.O. (1903).—B. 1861; ed. at Erasmus Smith Sch., Dub.; specification clk., S. Australia, 1876; profnl. clk., 3rd class, 1878; 1st class, 1883; sup. of pub. bldgs., 1886.

SMYTH, GEN. *SIR HENRY AUGUSTUS, K.C.M.G. (1890).—B. 1825; in command of the troops, S. Africa, 1889; gov. of Malta, 1890-3.

SNELLGROVE, J.—Apptd., after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. serv., and assigned to C.O. 22nd June, 1903.

SNOWBALL, JABEZ BUNTING.—Lieut.-gov., New Brunswick, Canada, 6th Feb., 1902.

SOLOMON, JOHN.—2nd-class asst. of excise, England, Apr., 1868; 1st-class asst., June, 1870; ride offr., June, 1871; resig., Jan., 1876; ag. 3rd clk., immigr. dept., Br. Guiana, July, 1877; ag. cashier in rec.-gen.'s office, 1878; comr. of taxation, 1879.

SOLOMON, MICHAEL CLAUDE.—Ag. 3rd-cl. clk., island med. dept., Jamaica, Mar., 1885; 3rd-cl. clk., Oct., 1888; 2nd-cl. clk., July, 1891.

SOLOMON, HON. SIR RICHARD, K.C.M.G. (1901), C.B. (1903), K.C.—Ed. S. African Coll., Capetown; St. Peter's Coll., Camb., 23rd wrangler; called to the bar, Inner Temple, 1879; legal adviser to late Lord Rosemark on his mission to Mauritius, 1886; mem. of native law comsn.; chmn. of mining comsn.; mem. of House of Ass. for division of Tembuland, Cape; atty.-gen., Cape, 1898-1900; legal adviser to Transvaal adminstrn., 1901-1902; atty.-gen., Transvaal, 19th June, 1902; mem. ex. and leg. couns.; mem. I.C.C.

SOLOMON, WM. HENRY.—B.A., Cantab; admitted to the bar, Inner Temple, 1877; practised in Cape Colony; asst. legal adviser, Cape, 1883; puisne judge, sup. ct., 1887; pres., spec. treason court, 1900; 1st puisne judge, Transvaal, 1902.

SOUZA, SIMON I., DE.—Ed. at the R. Catholic gram schl., Lagos; 1st despatch clk. and shorthand writer, col. sec.'s office, Lagos, June, 1895; acted as clk. of the legis. coun., 1900; regis. of correspondence, June, 1900; conf. clk. to gov. and clk. of leg. coun., July, 1901; ag. priv. sec. to gov., and clk. to ex. coun., Feb., 1902; in charge of Ibadan residency, Nov., 1903.

SORZANO, TILDEBER.—Draughtsman, crown lands office, Trinidad, 1874; first ditto, survey dept., Aug., 1881.

SPALDING, Lieut.-Col. WARNER WRIGHT, C.M.G. (1886).—B. 1844; N. S. Wales Artill., 1876; in command of the detachment which served in the Soudan, 1884; res. mag. Norfolk Is., 1896.

SPEED, EDWIN ARNFT.—M.A., LL.B.; ed. at Rugby, and Trin. Coll., Camb.; major scholar and senior exhibt., Rugby schl.; scholar and prize-man of Trin. Coll., Camb.; 1st cls. class. tripes, 1890; 2nd cls. law tripes, Part I., 1891; called to the bar, Inner Temple, June, 1893; dist. commsnr., G. Coast, 1899; atty.-gen., Lagos, 1900; edited a revised edition of Lagos laws, 1901; has acted on numerous occasions as ch. just. and also as col. sec., and has held a comsn. as dep. gov't.

SPENCE, FRANK.—3rd clk. col. sec.'s office, Fiji, 1880; clk. to commsnr. of wks., Oct., 1884; ag. priv. sec. to gov., 1884, 1885, and 1887 to 1896; sec. to consul-gen. for W. Pacific, 1889 to 1896; stip. mag., Cakandrove and Busa, 1896 to 1898; provincial inspr. and stip. mag., Cakandrove and Buia, 1899; ditto, Cakandrove, 1901; stip. mag., Navua, Jan., 1904.

SPENCE, J. B.—Med. supt. of Colombo lun. asyl., Ceylon, 1886.

SPENCE, R. O. H.—Cler. asst., P.W. dept., Br. Guiana, 16th Aug., 1886; ag. 2nd clk., P.W. dept., Aug., 1889; ag. 3rd-cl. clk., treasy., Jan., 1890; gov. offr., govt. ld. dept., Apr., 1890; clk., govt. ld. dept., May, 1890; sec., Bartika commsnr., June, 1891 to May, 1893; clk., dept. mines, Oct., 1892; ag. 3rd-cl. clk., dept. mines, Apr., 1893; govt. offr., dept. mines, July, 1893; J.P., May, 1894; comrn. to admr. oath, June, 1894; dist. govt. offr., dept. mines, Aug., 1896; warden, dept. mines, Nov., 1896; obd. certif. as sworn land surv., June, 1898; ag. ch. clk., dept. mines, Feb., 1900.

SPENCER, CYRIL E.—Ck., ch. sec.'s office, Cyprus, 1st Aug., 1892; passed in Mod. Greek, lower standard, Nov., 1893; clk., legis. coun., Mar., 1894; ag. priv. sec. to O.A.G., Jan.-Apr., 1898; inspr. of pol., May, 1898; ag. priv. sec. and clk. to ex. coun., Feb., May, 1899, and Dec., 1899, to May, 1900; ag. local comdt. of police, Papho, July, 1900, to June, 1901; Limassol, from June, 1901.

SPICER, QUINTEN HERBERT.—2nd clk., col. sec.'s dept., Tobago, 1884; 1st clk., audit and registry dept., 1884; 2nd rev. offr., 1895; harbrmr. and landing waiter, 1890; supervisor of excise 1892; inspr. of pol., 1896; in charge of prison, 1897; ast. harbrmr., Trinidad, 1899.

SPIRE, JOHN.—Apptd., after exam., 3rd-class messenger, C.O., Jan., 1883; 2nd class, July, 1896; Queen's mess., Nov., 1899.

SPRIGG, THE RT. HON. SIR JOHN GORDON, P.C. (1897), G.C.M.G. (1902), K.C.M.G. (1886).—B. 1830; has represented E. London in Cape assem. since 1869; col. sec. and premier, Feb., 1878, to May, 1881; col. treas., May, 1884, to Nov., 1886; premier, Nov., 1886; apptd. comdr. legion of honour for services in Paris Exhib., 1889; resig. office, July, 1890; again treas., 1893, and also premier, 1896; represented the col. in London at H.M.'s Diam. Jub.; resig. premiership, Oct., 1898; again premier 1900.

SPROULE, PERCY JULIAN, B.A., Camb.—Bar-rister-at-law (Mid. Tem.); cadet, S. S., Nov., 1896; ag. dep. registr., sup. ct., Penang, Mar., 1897; passed final in Malay, Mar., 1899; ag 3rd mag., Penang, June, 1899; dep. registr., sup. ct.,
Penang, Sept., 1899; ag. asst. regisr., sup. ct., Penang, May, 1903; ag. 2nd mag., Sing., Sept., 1904.

STAGG, SIDNEY.—Apptd., after compet. exam., clk. 2nd div. civil ser., and assigned to board of agriculture, Dec., 1897; transf. to C.O., Mar., 1899.

STANFORD, WALTER ERNEST MORTIMER, C.B. (1900), C.M.G. (1892).—B. 1850; mag.'s elk., Cape Col., 1863; mag., 1876; capt. of levies in Gcaleka war, 1877-8 (medal); mem. native laws and customs comm., 1880-2; comdt. in war of 1880-1; on special service to Pondoland, 1884; ch. mag. Griqualand E., 1885; negotiated treaty with Pondoos, 1886; sec. nat. affairs dept., 1888; ditto and ch. mag., July, 1904.

STANMORE, THE RIGHT HON. SIR ARTHUR HAMILTON GORDON, 1st Baron (creat. 1893), G.C.M.G. (1878), K.C.M.G. (1871), C.M.G. (1859).—B. 1829; priv. sec. to his father, Earl of Aberdeen, when 1st lord of the treas., 1852 to 1855; M.P. for Beverley from July, 1854, till Mar., 1857; accompanied Mr. Gladstone on his special mission as lord high commr. extraord. to the Ionian Is., Nov., 1858; capt. comdt. of the 1st Aberdeenshire R.V., Feb., 1860; lieut.-gov. of N. Brunswick, Oct., 1861; gov. of Trinidad, Nov., 1866; gov. of Mauritius, 1870; ret., 1874; gov. of the new col. of Fiji, Jan., 1875; H.M.'s high commr. and consul-gen. for the W. Pacific, 1877; gov. of N. Zealand, 1880; gov. of Ceylon, 1883; ret., 1890.

STANTON, LIONEL WM.—Inspr. of schls., S. Aust., 1876; asst. inspr.-gen., 1892; chmn. of bd. of inspr., 1896; inspr.-gen. of schls., 1902.

STEELE, WALTER MATTHEW.—Clerical asst., treasry., Br. Guiana, Feb., 1884; 5th class clk., Feb., 1886; 4th class, July, 1888; 3rd class, Apr., 1890; ag. clk.in-charge, sub-treasy., and savings bk., Dec., 1891, to June, 1893; 2nd class clk. (acctnt.), govt. land dept., April, 1896; asst. treas., So. Nigeria, July, 1904.

STEEN, DAVID MILLER, B.A.—Scholar, Queen's Coll., Belfast; 1st class exhibitioner, Roy. Univ.; B.A. 1896; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., 1887; pol. mag., Balapitiya, 1889; asst. collr., customs, Trincomalee, 1890; ditto, Galle, 1892; pol. mag., Haldemulla, 1893; ag. dist. judge, Badulla, 1893; ag. dist. judge, Tangalla, 1895.

STEERE, C. J. LEK.—Probation clk., col. sec.'s off., W. Aust., Feb., 1885; jun. clk., Aug., 1885; ag. clk., gov.'s off., 1889-1900; clk. of leg. coun. and clk. of parlts., Dec., 1890, to June, 1901; clk. of leg. assem., June, 1901.

STEIN, JOHN.—Ed. at Christ's Coll., Finchley, and at Neuwied, Germany; sec. to consulates for Germany, Sweden and Norway, and Denmark, in Mauritius, May, 1889, to Dec., 1896; apptd. by S. of S., F.O., an asst. dist. commr. in H.B.M.'s Niger Coast Protectorate, April, 1897; ag. dist. commr., Opopo, June, 1897, to June, 1898; Bonny, Jan., 1899, to Jan., 1900; promoted dist. commr., Jan., 1900; asst. sec. to govt., Southern Nigeria, June, 1900; ag. sec. to govt., Sept., 1900, to May, 1901, and from June to Nov., 1901; West African medal with clasp, 1899; ment. in desps. for services in connection with Aro expedition, 1901-2; ret., 1904.

STEPHEN, CHELVUM.—Ind. interp. to res. mag., Durban, Natal, Jan., 1875; clk. and Ind. interp. to res. mag. Umlazi div., co. of Durban, Mar., 1876; Tamil interp., sup. ct., 1895.

STEPHEN, GUY NEVILLE.—Ed. Paris, Marseilles, London; M.R.C.S., Eng., 1881; licentiate of medicine, Franco, 1882; ag. house surg., Lincoln co. hosp.; ditto, asst. med. offr., Middlesex co. asylum (Colney Hatch); surg. to the consulate of Norway and Sweden, Marseilles, 1881; surg. to the Br. Consulate and Seamen's Home, Marseilles, 1882; dist. med. offr., Nicosia, Cyprus, 1883; med. offr., central prison, gen. and ophthalmic hosp.; med. offr. of health, Nicosia; pres. of the municipality, Nicosia, 1889; ag. ch. med. offr., 1885 and 1890; surg. to Smyrna Hosp., 1894.

STEPHEN, SIR MATTHEW HENRY, K.T. BACH. (1904).—Mem. legis. assem., N.S.W., 1869-71; judge, sup. ct., May, 1887.

STEPHEN, WILLIAM WILBERFORCE.—Clk., col. secretariat, N. S. Wales, 1852; priv. sec. to various premiers, 1856-58; clk., land dept., 1858; under-sea. for lands, 1870; sec., atty.-gen.'s dept., 1880.

STEPHENS, THOMAS NOAKES.—Jun. offr. S. Australia; customs, 1864; clk., marine bd., 1865; boarding offr., customs, 1866; asst. landing waiter, 1867; confid. clk., 1870; ch. clk., treasy., 1875; sec. marine bd., 1877; sec. of customs, 1889; under-treas., 1890; collr. of customs, regisr. of shipping, ch. inspr. of distilleries and excise, pres. of marine bd., 1894; is a J.P.; transf. with cust. dept. to serv. of Commonwealth of Aust., 1st Jan. 1901.

STEPHENSON ALBERT EDWARD.—Clk. E. and A. dept., Feb., 1884; local auditor, Lagos, Aug., 1888, also ag. local auditor, G. Coast, Dec., 1888, to Aug., 1889; returned to E. and A. depts. and apptd. to col. audit branch, Jan., 1891; clk. in charge of accts., May, 1893; asst. supt., Aug., 1897.

STEVENS, FRED. G.—B.A., Oxon.; ed. at Winchester and New Coll., Oxford; cadet, Strait Settlements, Oct., 1902; demarcation offr., Sing., 15th June, 1903; dep. coll. of land rev. and regisr. of deeds, Sing., in addtn. to other duties, Oct., 1903; ag. dist. offr., Malacca, June, 1904; passed final exam. in Malay, July, 1904.

STEVENS, PERCIVAL.—Asst. M.I.C.E.: asst. engnr. govt. rly., Trinidad, 1874; dist. engnr., Couva extension rly., 1878; req. engnr. in charge of construction, San Fernando and Guaiacara rlys., 1879; 1st asst. engnr. P.W. dept., Jan., 1885; has acted as asst. dir. of P.W., 1886, 6, 8, 9, and 90; engnr., N. div., P.W.D., Jan., 1892; 1st engnr. in charge of rds. and bdges., P.W.D., Jan., 1894; engnr. in charge of rds. and bdges., rds. and bdges. dept., Jan., 1895; ag. dir. pub. wks., with seat in legis. coun., May, 1894, to Feb., 1896.

STEVENS, THOMAN HAMILTON.—2nd clk. in treasy., Antigua, 1873; clk. in treasy., St. Kitts, 1874; supervisor of customs, G. Coast Col., 1880; in charge of special expenditure in connection with Ashantee difficulty, 1881; acted as paymr., G. Coast constab., 1882; commr. of Elmina, 1882; in charge of dist. chest, Accra, 1884; paymr. of constab., 1885; dist. commr. of Dixcove, 1886; Elmina, 1886 and 1887; financial asst. to pol. Singapore, 1888; ag. asst. audr.-gen., S. S., Nov. to Dec., 1896.

STEWARD, MAJ.-GEN. EDWARD HARDING, C.M.G. (1887).—B. 1836; entered army, Roy. Engrs., Oct., 1854; employed from 1865 to 1879 in the fortification branch of the W.O.; services lent in 1866 to 1869, and in 1877 to the S. Australian govt., and in 1877 till 1879 to the govt. of Victoria. In charge of the defence of the Natal frontier in 1879, and comdt. of Natal and mem. of exec. coun. of the col. in 1880; services lent to govt. of Victoria and N. S. Wales in 1883; and in 1884, on retirement from the army, became military adviser to the agts.-gen. of Victoria, N. S. Wales, Queensland, S. Australia, N. Zealand, and Tasmania.
STEWARD, GEORGE.—Ck., Tasmanian govt. rly., June, 1892; ch. ck. and acctnt., education dept., July, 1893; sec. to premier of Tasmania, Aug., 1894; ck. to ex. coun., Jan., 1895; and sec. to defence comtee., June, 1895, in addition; under sec. for Tasmania, Jan., 1896; and ch. inspr. of explosives and magazines, 1st Sept., 1897, in addition; raised and commanded first company of mtd. infantry in Tasmania, and holds rank of captain; ch. ck., dept. of external affairs, Commonwealth govt., 18th May, 1901; offi. sec. to gov.-gen., and sec. to fed. ex. coun., 24th Dec., 1902.

STEWART, A.—Rea. mag., Victoria E., Cape Col., Jan., 1882; transf'd to Albert, 1884.

STEWART, CAPT. SIR D., K.C.M.G. (1902), C.M.G. (1897).—Joined 92nd Gordon Hinds. 1879; served in Afghan war, 1879-80; present at Lord Robert's march from Cabul to Candahar (severely wnd.), med. and clasp, star for the march; served with 92nd in Transvaal war, 1881; A.D.C. to comdr.-in-chief in India, 1882 to 1884; served with mtd. infnty., Soudan campgn. of 1884-5, med. and clasp, Khedive's star; served as political offr. with Ashanti expdn. of 1896, star; Res. of Ashanti, 1896; served in ntnrn. territories G. Coast, 1897, at the occupn. of Gambaga and connected operations; comsnr. and commdr.-in-chief, B. East Africa Prot., 1904.

STEWART, JOHN MARCUS.—Ck., pol. ct., Queensland, 1887; ditto, pol. dept., 1888; sec. pol. investmt. bd., 1898; acctnt., pol. dept., 1899; sub-lieut. in Queensland and Commwth. of Aust. naval forces, 1st Nov., 1899, to 31st Jan., 1904; asst. treas., N. Nigeria, 6th Aug., 1904.

STEWART, MAJ.-GEN. SIR ROBERT MACGREGOR, K.C.B. (1902).—B. 1842; served in Hazara campaign, 1868; Afghan war, 1878-9; Soudan, 1885; A.D.C. to Queen Victoria, 1887-97; late commdr., R.A., southn. dist., Portsmouth; gov. Bermuda, 19th Mar., 1904.

STIGAND, ALMAR GORDON.—2nd ck. to res. comsnr. for Bech. Prot. at Mafeking, 1898; 1st ck. and regis. to res. comsnr., 1899; served in town guard during siege of Mafeking, Oct., 1899, to May, 1900; ck. of ct. and ck. to asst. comsnr., Gaberones, 1902; J.P.; Bech. Prot., 1903; ag. asst. comsnr., Jan. to Feb., 1904.

STILES, ALFRED.—Apptd., after exam., messenger C.O., Dec., 1875; Queen's mess., Aug., 1882; asst. off. keeper, 17th Feb., 1900.

STILWELL, E. A.—Sarawak civ. ser., roads and bridges dept., Mar., 1888; asst. res., Baram, Oct., 1894; of Sadong, May, 1895; res., 2nd class, Jan., 1897.

STIRLING, SIR JOHN LANCELOT, KT. BACH. (1902), B.A., LL.B.—B. 1849; mem. leg. coun., S. Aust., 1891; chief sec., 1899; pres. leg. coun., 1901.

STIRLING, RIGHT REV. W. H., D.D.—Bishop of the Falklands.

STOKER, WILLIAM HENRY, K.C.—Called to the bar, Mid. Temp.; atty.-gen., Leeward Is., Mar., 1898; mem. fed. and island ex. and leg. couns.; ag. 1st puisne judge conjointly with atty.-gen., Nov. to Dec., 1901; atty.-gen., Barbados, July, 1902; chrmn., Barbados quarantine coman., 1902-3; K.C., Barbados, 3rd April, 1903; M.L.C., Apl. to Oct., 1903; ag. pres. of educn. bd., May to June, 1903; ag. ch. just., 1st Aug. to 30th Oct., 1903; deleg. for Barbados, and elec. pres. at Brit. W. India conf. on quarantine, Apl. to May, 1904.

STONE, SIR E. A., KT. BACH. (1902).—B. 1844; ck. to atty.-gen., W. Australia, 1860; called to bar, 1865; ck. to legis. coun., 1870; nominee mem. of ditto, 1880-2; crown solr., 1882; puisne judge, 1884; acted as ch. just., 1880, 1881, 1887, and 1889; ch. just., 1901; admstr., 1901-2.

STONE, E. C. M.—Ck. to regis., Trinidad, 1875; ch. ck., 1878; ck. of complaint ct., 1878; ch. ck. to regis., sup. ct., 1880; regis., ct. of survey, 1883; ag. regis., sup. ct., 1880, 1881, 1883, and Apr., 1884, to July, 1885, and June to Sept., 1886; ch. ck. to regis.-gen., Sept., 1887; dep. regis.-gen., Oct., 1889; ag. regis.-gen., 1892-93; is a comnr. of affidavits, and sup. regis. of births and deaths for Port of Spain.

STONE, HERBERT C.—Entered Trinidad service, Apr., 1863; ast. clk. of the peace, Port of Spain, May, 1864; ag. clk. of the peace, W. dist., co. of St. Patrick, July, 1865; 3rd ck., immigr. office, Mar., 1866; 2nd ck., June, 1867; ag. ch. clk., 1868-9; ag. stip. mag., co. of St. David's, and ward of Blanchisseuse, and warden of the Toco ward union, Feb., 1872; inspr. of immigrts., Nov., 1872; ag. warden and supervisor of the Caroni ward union, Feb., 1876; J.P. for the town of Port of Spain and counties of St. George and Caroni, May, 1876; inspr. and sub-prot. of immigrts., 1st Jan., 1882; ag. prot. of immigrts., 1882, 1887, and 1889-92, with seat in legis. coun.; mem. bd. of educn., June, 1892; ag. rec.-gen., with seat in legis. coun., 1892.

STOUT, THE HON. SIR ROBERT, K.C.M.G. (1886).—B. 1844; admitted a barrister of sup. ct., N. Zealand; entered the prov. coun. of Otago, N.Z., 1872; prov. solr., 1873; elected to the gen. assem., 1875; atty.-gen., Mar., 1878, to June, 1879; min. of lands, etc., for immigr., 1878; pres. of Dunedin Freethought Soc.; prime min. and atty.-gen., and min. for educn. 1884-87; fellow of N. Z. Univ.; chief justice of N.Z., 1889.

STRACHAN, W. HENRY W., C.M.G. (1902), L.R.C.P. (Lond.), M.R.C.S. (Eng.), F.L.S.—Jun. res. med. offr., pub. hosp., Kingston, Jamaica, 1882; sen. res. med. offr., 1885; sen. med. offr., 1892; mem. of bd. of govrs., Inst. of Jamaica, 1892; chief med. offr. of Lagos, Dec., 1897; acted as col. sec., Dec., 1899, to Mar., 1900.

STRACHEY, CHARLES.—Apptd., after compet. exam., 2nd cl. jun. clk., F.O., 2nd Apr., 1886; 1st cl. jun. clk., 1st May, 1883; sec. Uganda rly. comte., 10th Sept., 1895; 1st cl. clk., C.O., 20th Nov., 1898.

STRANGE, WM. LUMISDEN, M.I.C.E.—Served in pub. wks. dept., India, 1879 to 1903; undersec., ditto, July, 1901; dir. of irrigtn. and water supply, Transvaal, 25th Apl., 1903; author of "Indian storage reservoirs with earthen drains."

STRATHCONA AND MOUNT ROYAL, LORD, 1ST BARON (U.K. creat. 1897), SIR DONALD A. SMITH, G.C.M.G. (1896), K.C.M.G. (1886).—B. 1820; Gov. of Hudson's Bay Territory; special commnr., Red River, 1869; mem. of Canadian parlmt., 1871, dir. of Canadian Pacific Rly., 1880; high commnr. for Canada, 1896; mem. of Pacific Cable Comtees, 1886 and 1899; Lord Rector of Aberdeen Univ., 1899.

STRATTON, GEORGE BERNARD.—Ed. Warwick and Durham Univ.; cadet, S. S., Nov., 1899; passed final exam. in Malay, Dec., 1900; ag. aspt. govt. printing office, Jan., 1901; ag. 4th mag., Sing., Mar., 1901; ag. aspt. of education, Penang, Dec., 1901; on spec mission to Pulau Weh, Jan., 1904; ag. 2nd asst. col. sec., Apl., 1904.

STRAWBRIDGE, WILLIAM.—Entered survey and crown lands dept., S. Australia, as cadet, June, 1862; after several promotions, was apptd. examr. of licensed survr.'s work and draftsman, June, 1872; and ch., draftsman, Apr., 1877; dep.
survr.-gen., July, 1886; survr.-gen., July, 1894; chmn. of pastoral, central pastoral, and central land bds.

STREATFEILD FRANK N., C.M.G. (1879).—B. 1843; comdt. of levies, S. Africa war, 1877-8-9; R.M. Transkei, 1878-84; C.C. Kuruman, B. Bech., 1887-9.

STRICKLAND, SIR GERALD, COUNT DELLA CATENA, K.C.M.G. (1897), C.M.G. (1889).—B. 1861; ed. Oscott Coll., Birmingham; lieut. C.U.R.V., and elected mem. coun. of govt., Malta, 1886; B.A. and LL.B., Trin. Coll., Camb., honours law tripoe; attended col. conf., 1887, on behalf of Malta; called to the bar, Inn. Temp., and pres. cholera coman., Malta, 1887; thanked by govt. for negotiations on Imp. veto of appts. to See of Malta; unoffic. mem., ex. coun., and ag. ass't sec. to govt., 1888; vice-pres., bd. of health, pres. comtee. of privileges, ch. sec. to govt., and major, Royal Malta militia, which he established, 1889; re-organized Malta rlyw., 1891; planned breakwater, 1894; pres., coun. of Malta univ., 1900; chrmn., mil. and civ. drainage bd.; mem. comtee. on Malta naval reserves; gov. and comdr.-in-chief, Leeward Is., 1902; estab. central factories for sugar and cotton in Antigua, 1903; gov., Tasmania, 23rd July, 1904.

STRICKLAND, R. B., M.A. (Dublin).—Inspr. of schools, Ceylon, 29th Aug., 1902.

STRONG, THE RT. HON. SIR SAMUEL HENRY, P.C. (1897), KT. BACh. (1893).—Born in Dorsetshire, Eng., 1825; called to bar of Ontario, 1849; created Q.C., 1863; elected a bencher of the Law Soc. of Upper Canada, 1860; a comsnr. for consolidating the statutes of Upper Canada and Canada respectively, Dec., 1866; a mem. of the law reform coman., 1871; vice-chancellor Ontario, Dec., 1869; puisne judge of the ct. of error and appeal, same prov., 1874; puisne judge of the sup. ct. of the Dominion, 1875; ch. just. of Canada, 1892; apptd. to the judicial comtee. of H.M.'s privy coun., 1897.

STROUD, BENJ.—Suptdng. sergt., Barbados; pol. supt., 1876; 3rd class landg. waiter, Sept., 1881.

STUART, ALEXR.—Ed. St. Andrew's Univ.; regiar. of impta. and expts., Singapore, Sept., 1890; temporarily attached to patent office, London, 1897-8.

STUART, JAMES.—Ed. St. John's Coll., Hurstpierpoint; matric. Lond. and Cape; silver medal, Natal, Eng. lit. exam., 1891; clk. G.P.O., Pietermaritzburg, Feb., 1888; clk. and interp., R.M., Eshowe, May, 1888; 1st clk. and interp. to res. comsnr. and ch. mag., Zululand, Feb., 1889; acted on various occasions as sec., res. comsnr. and res. ch. mag.'s ct., Zululand; interp. to Br. comsnr., Swaziland, 1894 to 1896; and in charge of Swazi deputations to Capetown and England in 1894; acted as Br. consul, Swaziland, 1895; R.M., Ingavuma dist., Zululand, 1895; mag. Lower Tugela div., 1899; asst. mag., Durban div., 1901; mag. for colony, 1902.

STUART, JAS. MARTIN.—Comsnr. of insolvency, S. Australia, June, 1883; stip. mag., Port Adelaide, July, 1881; crown solr., 1890.

STUART COL. JOHN ALEXANDER MAN, C.B. (Mil., 1900), C.M.G. (1897), KT. OF JUSTICE OF ST. JOHN OF JERUSALEM (1903).—B. 1841; served with the field force under the late Brigadier Murray, R.A.; employed on the 30-mile radius round Shanghai during the summer of 1863 (medal); also with the Anglo-Chinese contingent in Col. Gordon's Taeping campaigns of 1863-64, being present during the operations before Soo-chow, and at the siege and storming of Chang-chow (Chinese medal and Precious Star 2nd class); in 1868-69 was stationed in Formosa, and assisted the U.S. Consul and Mr. W.A. Pickering, C.M.G., in concluding a friendly settlement with the savage tribes; took part in the negotiations at Fort Zeelandia and withdrawal of Br. force (mentioned in despatches); selected in 1873 to raise a corps of mil. pol. for the Treaty dist. of Newchwang, S. Manchuria, at that time infested by mounted banditti, and subsequently commanded the force embodied (thanks of the Br. and Ital. ministers, and of the Imp. High Comm., with the brevet of col. in the Chinese army, and the cross of the Ital. Crown, 4th class); served with the Nile expdn. of 1884-5 as boat. offr. and staff. offr., and afterwards as comdt. at Dal (medal with clasp and Khedive's star); A.D.C. to Gen. Valentine Baker, Pasha, in 1886; and ag. dep. inspr. gen. of gendarmerie in 1886-7-8 (thanks of Egyptian Govt., and Order of the Osmanieh, 4th class); comdt. of local forces, Trinidad and Tobago, 1891 to 1897; comdt. at base and on line of communication, Ashanti camp, 1900 (twice mentd. in desps., medal).

STUBBS, REGINALD EDWARD.—Ed. at Radley and Corpus Christi Coll., Oxford (exhibitor); 1st cl. classical mods., 1897; 1st cl. lit. hum., 1899; B.A., 1899; apptd., after compet. exam., 2nd cl. clk., C.O., Jan., 1900.

SULLIVAN, ADMIRAL SIR FRANCIS W., BART., R.N., K.C.B. (1879), C.B. (1864), C.M.G. (1878), B. 1834; entered the royal navy, 1848; comdr. of "Harrier" in N. Zealand, 1862-4, during Maori war; present at Koheroa, Rauarangi and other minor affairs; promoted capt., 1863, and rear-admiral, 1878; commodore on the Cape and African station, 1877 to 1879, during operations in the Cape and Zululand; received the thanks of both houses of parlmt. for his services in connection with the Egyptian expdn., 1882; vice-admiral, 1886; dir. of transports, admiralty, 1883.

SULLIVAN, W. W., K.C.—Atty. gen. and premier of Prince Edward Is., Canada; born in P.E.I., 1843; called to the bar 1867; elected to legislature in 1872, and has continuously represented the same constituency; created a Q.C. by the govt. of P.E.I., 1876, and by the govt.-gen. of Canada 1879; is a dep. judge in the admity. ct., pres. of the bd. of educn., and pres. of the bd. of trustees of P.E.I. Hosp. for the Insane; was a mem. of the exec. coun., holding the office of solr.-gen., Apr., 1873, till Sept., 1876; leader of the Opposition in the legislature in 1877; became prime min. and atty. and advoc.-gen. in 1879, which position he continues to hold; has been a deleg. representing the prov. govt. on several occasions in Canada, and was deleg. to England in 1886, to confer with the impv. govt. regarding the terms of confederation between P.E.I. and Canada; ch. just., P.E.I., 1889.

SUTER, WM. CHAR.—Aest. master, govt. English schla., Singapore, 22nd Nov., 1884; ch. clk., col. sec.'s office, 1st July, 1888; shorthand reporter to leg. coun. in addition to other duties, 1st July, 1887.

SUTHERLAND, WM.—Apptd. to Fiji civ. ser., Jan., 1880; clk. recr.-gen.'s office, Sept., 1880; clk. regiar.-gen., Jan., 1882; stip. mag. of the col., Apl., 1883; ag. collr. of cust., Sept., 1897; ag. recr.-gen., Mar., 1898; native comsnr., 1898; ag. col. sec. and recr.-gen., Jan., 1903.

SUTTOR, THE HON. SIR FRANCIS B., KT. BACh. (1903).—Postmtr.-gen., N.S. Wales, Aug., 1890, to Nov., 1881; min. of pub. instruction, 1881 to 1883.
and again, 1891-4; representative of col. at col. confere., Ottawa, 1894.

SWAIN, ALFRED WILLIAM.—Clerical ast., regisr.'s off., Barbados, 1879; Jun. clk., G.P.O., Br. Guiana, June, 1881; 3rd cls. clk., Jan., 1883; 2nd cls., Dec., 1889; 1st-class, Apr., 1900; ch. elk., Sept., 1900; ag. postmtr.-gen., May, 1901, to May, 1902; and Aug. to Dec., 1904; 2nd lieut. Br. Guiana volunteers, 1889, ditto militia, 1891; lieut., 1892; capt., 1896; maj., 1900; ag. comdt., of local forces, July, 1901, to Feb., 1902; Hythe certif., 1898; Colonial and Aux. forces long service medal; recd. thanks of govt. on retiring in 1902, and retains rank of Major.

SWAIN, ARTHUR CLAUDE.—2nd elk., crown lands dept., Br. Guiana, Oct., 1879; ast. comnr., May, 1882; dist. ditto, July, 1881; is J.P.

SWAIN, GEORGE DOUGLAS.—1st elk. and bookkeeper, pol dept., Br. Guiana, Apr., 1882; inspr. of pol., May, 1884; ch. inspr., Mar., 1892; ag. dep. inspr.-gen., July to Sept., 1893; on special service with Mr. McTurk, Feb., 1896, to take over Ururan from Venezuelana, remaining in command there till July, 1895; vol. in Ashanti expdn., Nov., 1895, to Mar., 1896; mentioned in despatches (star); two months' training with R.I.C. at Dublin, 1890; Hythe, P.S., and 1st cl. ambulance certif.; ag. dep. inspr.-gen., Aug., 1896, to Jan., 1899; promoted ch. county inspr., and 2nd in command, 18th Nov., 1899; ag. insp.-gen., 10th May to 21st Aug., 1900; served on comm. apptd. to inquire into adminstr. of poor law relief, 1900; ag. inspr.-gen. of police, and col. comdt. of militia, 8th May to 3rd Sept., 1902; deputy inspr.-gen. of police, Trinidad, 30th September, 1903.

SWAMY, PONNAMBALAM COOMARA.—Mem. legis. coun., Ceylon, and mun. coun., Colombo; proctor, sup. ct., and notary public; served on comm. to inquire into and report on financial condition of Colombo municipality.

SWAN, ROBERT A.—Matric. at Madras Univ., Dec., 1868; passed special law test prescribed for unconvicted supts. and ast.-supts. of pol.; 2nd-class inspr. of pol. in the Cuddapah dist., Madras, May, 1870; in Aug., 1871, 1st-class; May, 1874, passed in Telugu; Oct., 1876, special ast. to sub-collr. and joint mag. of Cuddapah for famine relief duty, and in same month apptd. mag., and placed in charge of the Kadri and Madnapully Taluqs of Cuddapah dist.; in Feb., 1877, stip. mag. Mauritius; Jan., 1878, stip. mag. of Flaoc; and in Aug., 1879, Grand Port and Savanne; mem. of comm. to frame regula. under "labour ordinance of 1878"; member of Lincoln's Inn, 1882; called to the bar, 1887; stip. mag. Br. Guiana, Nov., 1883; in July, 1884, sent on special duty to Madras to organise an emigrn. agency for Br. Guiana; sheriff, Essequibo co., Dec., 1887; chmn. lands titles inquiry comm., Feb., 1890; a revising barrister under Br. Guiana Constnt. Order, 1891; sheriff of Berbice and mag. New Amsterdan, 1892; acted as pol. mag. Georgetown, Feb., 1890, and Oct., 1894, to Apr., 1895; mem. of comm. on poor-relief, 6th Apr., 1900; chairman of ditto, 7th Sept., 1900; appt. as pol. mag. Georgetown, confirmed by S. of S., 1st Oct., 1900; ag. pulse judge, sup. ct., 1st Oct., 1900; pulse judge, Trinidad, 3rd Aug., 1903.

SWAYNE, CHARLES RICHARD.—Stip. mag., Fiji; inspr. of native taxes, 1876; stip. mag. and commr. of sup. ct., Lau prov., 1878; sent to Kadava with special authority in native matters, 1879 and 1880; inspr. of Indian and Polynesian labourers, Lau prov., 1883; stip. mag., regisr., and commr. of sup. ct. at Levuka, 1885; returned to Lau, 1886; ast. nat. commr., Lau, 1888; ag. Br. res., Gilbert and Ellice Is., and special judicial commr. for trial of certain cases, Oct., 1893, to Nov., 1895; stip. mag., Rewa, and commr., Naitasiri, 1898; ag. nat. commr., and mem. ex coun., July, 1901, to Sep., 1902; commr. Naitasiri, Sep. 1902; ag. commr., Rewa, July-Dec., 1903.

SWEET-ESCOTT, SIR E. R., K.C.M.G. (1904), C.M.G. (1896).—B. 1857; ed. Somersetshire Coll., Bath, and at Balliol Coll., Oxon; exhibitioner, Worce. Coll., Oxon, June, 1876; 2nd class classical moda, June, 1878; 3rd class in hist. finals, June, 1880; B.A., July, 1880; classical prof. at the Roy. Coll., Mauritius, June, 1881; précis writer, col. sec.'s office, Feb., and 2nd ast. col. sec., Apl., 1886; ag. col. sec., 1889; ag. col. sec., Br. Honduras, Mar., 1893; admtd. the govt. of that col., Apr. to Nov., 1893; col. sec., Br. Honduras, 1894; admtd. govt. Apl. to Nov., 1895, again in 1897; ag. 1st-class clkr., C.O., Jan., 1898; admstr. of the Seychelles Is., Aug., 1899; assumed govt., 20th Nov., 1899; gov. and comdr.-in-chief, Oct., 1903; gov., B. Honduras. 15th Apl., 1904.

SWEETENHAM, SIR F., ATHELSTANE, K.C.M.G.(1897), C.M.G.(1886).—B.1850; cadet, S. Stiltsnts, July, 1870; passed final exam. in Malay, July, 1872; ast. collr. of land rev. for Penang and Prov. Wellesley, Aug., 1872; collr. of land rev., July, 1873; J.P. and mag. and commr., et al. of requesta, Penang, May, 1874; sent on special missions to Perak in Jan., June, and July, 1874; sent to reside with the Sultan of Selangor, Aug., 1874; ast. res., Selangor, Dec., 1874; gazetted to act temporarily as res. of Selangor, 22nd Oct., 1875; took charge of the residency in Perak on the murder of the res., Nov., 1875; dep. commr., Perak, Nov., 1875; mentioned in despatches; ast. col. sec. for native states, Mar., 1876; ast. col. sec., July, 1881; Br. res., Selangor, Sept., 1882; commr. for S. S. and Malay States, Calcutta Exhibtn., 1883-84; ag. Br. res. Perak, Mar., 1894, to Jan., 1896; exec. commr. for S. S. and Malay States, Col. and Ind. Exhibtn., 1896; Br. res., Perak, 1898; res.-gen. Malay States, Jan., 1896; admtd. govt. S. S., Feb., 1900; gov., 1901; ret. 1904.

SWEETENHAM, SIR J. A., K.C.M.G. (1898), C.M.G. (1892).—B. 1846; ed. Clare Coll., Camb.; scholarship, May, 1867; writer, Ceylon service, 1868; ag. pol. mag., Harrispattu, Feb., 1870; pol. mag., Kayta, Sept., 1870, continuing to act at Harrispattu; ag. astt. govt. agt., Galle, Dec., 1871; ag. landing and tide survr., Galle, June, 1872; ast. collr. of customa, Jaffna, Oct., 1872, to continue to act at Galle; ag. dist. judge, Matara, Apr., 1873; 2nd ast. col. sec., and clk. of the legis. coun., 1876; rec.-gen., Cyprus, 1883; audr.-gen., Ceylon, 1891; col. sec., S.
